Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
I discard one master card to make chas action fail. Can i burn one blood on
synesios to be able to keep my master phase action on the next turn ?

thank you

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Reyda wrote:
>
> I discard one master card to make chas action fail. Can i burn one blood on
> synesios to be able to keep my master phase action on the next turn ?

No. Synesios's ability is only usable when you "play" a <X>.
Discarding one doesn't count.
